item.title: Should copilotUserPreferences.md be repetitive and verbose?
item.body:
<!-- Please search existing issues to avoid creating duplicates -->
<!-- Please attach logs to help us diagnose your issue -->

Hi, this may be closer to a user question than a bug report, but I was reviewing copilotUserPreferences.md (in ~/Library/Application Support/Code - Insiders/User/globalStorage/github.copilot-chat/copilotUserPreferences.md), and it reads repetitive and wordy. Is there some reason it should be a contrast to concise, tight instructions we normally aim for in the prompts and instructions? What is the process and frequency that copilotUserPreferences.md refreshes? I've been tinkering with copilot-instructions.md, codeGeneration.instructions, commitMessageGeneration.instructions, etc., to make them tighter. 

- Copilot Chat Extension Version: 1.272.1380
- VS Code Version: vscode/1.98.0-insider
- OS Version: Sequoia 15.2
- Logs:

1. Go to ~/Library/Application Support/Code - Insiders/User/globalStorage/github.copilot-chat/copilotUserPreferences.md
